description: Part-load electrical + thermal extraction efficiency with ambient temperature derating for backpressure/extraction steam turbine CHP

unit.name: Generic 10 MW Extraction/Backpressure Steam Turbine CHP
unit.source: US EPA CHP Catalog (2017); Kehlhofer, R. et al. (2009). Combined-Cycle Gas & Steam Turbine Power Plants, 3rd ed. PennWell; IEA (2008). Combined Heat and Power — Evaluating the Benefits of Greater Global Investment.

P_el_rated_kw.note: Rated electrical output at ISO conditions

eta_el_rated.note: Electrical efficiency at full load (backpressure steam turbine: 20-30%)

eta_th_rated.note: Thermal (steam extraction / exhaust) efficiency at full load; total ~89%

PLR_min.note: Minimum stable PLR (sliding pressure operation limit)

el_plr_c.note: Electrical PLR quadratic term; peaks near PLR=0.85

th_plr_a.note: Thermal PLR constant (heat extraction decreases proportionally less than electrical at part load)

T_ref_c.note: ISO reference ambient temperature (15 degC for steam plant condenser)

temp_derating_pct_per_degC.note: Power derating above 15 degC (condenser back-pressure rises with ambient)
